deviations.what: t8 added a small engine feature: a step with config.on_error 'skip' that ends failed becomes skipped (its error kept, history failure_tolerated), accepted only on non-loop, non-wait steps; the newspaper's summary step uses it so the issue still goes out when cortex is down
deviations.reason: the engine had no way for a workflow to survive a failed step, which the confirmed cortex-down decision (q1) needs

deviations.what: t8 adjusted t6's builtins to how for_each works: newspaper.filter reads the loop's implicit item port; newspaper.sections adds a derived query (the section's queries joined with OR, refused over Brave's 400 characters); render accepts per-iteration {results} objects. The library actor uses the operator's existing grant XTEINK_PUSH_API_KEY instead of a new XTEINK_NEWSPAPER_KEY, and all four actors are placed on spark because the LLM gateway and xteink are reached on spark's localhost (live test)
deviations.reason: a loop body cannot receive the item under another name, params cannot index a list, and a for_each output yields whole iteration objects; the grant name and placement come from the operator and the live component test

deviations.what: Codex round 1 on #53: newspaper.issue moves to newspaper_issue.py with a lease fenced by run id (phases claim, before_email, before_push, record), per-destination progress and a stored email payload with the durable key newspaper:<date>:email (email.send gains an optional idempotency_key param); a summary window from the slot (claim config summary_window_s, default 600 s) passed to llm.complete as not_after (llm_deadline); LimitedActor asks an inner port's refuse_before_admit before taking or waiting for a pool slot; a tolerated failure clears the step's outputs; render tokenises formatting and requires bullets-only summaries with a source link on every line; Brave drops a result whose URL does not parse
deviations.reason: Codex found a double email after a partial delivery (P1) and five P2 issues; the pool hook is a small change in the shared limits layer
